_comment: NAME SAVE FLOW STEP 2 'No original intent' sub-branch coverage for Alpine Osteopaths (Template A — formal tone). Modeled on nodes/clinics/intuitive_health_and_wellness/node_1_entry_greeting_router_scenarios.json.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-yes — caller confirms name update with no other request → single greeting, zero tool call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Sylvia.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — should I update your patient record to Sylvia for future calls and bookings?
Sure.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update (STEP 2 YES) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet — the 'No original intent' sub-branch applies. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'Hi Sylvia! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent single greeting) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — save_caller_name/patient_name_raw flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn — that produces a DV update mid-turn and risks the greeting being spoken twice in the same call (same bug class as conv_1401m1djt060fmzbz5gv7887ggf3, 2026-09-01). FAIL if: agent speaks the greeting more than once.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-no — caller declines name update with no other request → single ack, zero tool call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Priya.
Hi Priya! I have this number saved under Tyson — should I update your patient record to Priya for future calls and bookings?
No, leave it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller declined the name update (STEP 2 NO) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'No problem! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — phone_owner_denied/patient_name_raw flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn. FAIL if: agent speaks more than once.

scenarios.name: name-save-with-book-intent-yes — caller states name AND booking intent together → ack + tool call still fires (regression check)

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Sylvia — I'd like to book an appointment.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — should I update your patient record to Sylvia for future calls and bookings?
Yes please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update AND already stated a booking intent in the Step 1 turn — the book_intent sub-branch applies, not 'No original intent'. PASS if: agent speaks 'Hi Sylvia!' (or equivalent single line) AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with save_caller_name='true' in the payload, in the same turn. FAIL if: agent makes zero tool calls (that would strand the booking request). FAIL if: agent speaks the generic 'How can I help you today?' greeting instead of proceeding with the booking.

scenarios.name: intercept-trigger-b-booking — indirect booking wording inside dictated message → cancel/book offer, zero tool call

history.content: Can you leave a message for Dr Chen?
Sure, what would you like me to pass on?
Tell her it's Maria — I've been getting worse pain and could really use getting in sooner rather than later.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The immediately preceding assistant turn asked for message content, and the caller's reply contains indirect/hedged booking wording ('could really use getting in sooner') — this is INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT Trigger B, BOOKING. PASS if: agent speaks exactly 'It sounds like you'd like to book an appointment — I can help with that now. Shall I go ahead?' (or a close equivalent of that BOOKING offer line) with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn (execution belongs to STEP 2, not this turn). FAIL if: agent instead proceeds straight to ordinary LEAVE MESSAGE handling and never offers to book.

scenarios.name: intercept-trigger-b-cancel — indirect cancel wording inside dictated message → cancel offer, zero tool call

history.content: Can you pass a message on to reception?
Of course — what would you like me to tell them?
It's Daniel — I've hurt my shoulder and won't be able to make it in tomorrow.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The immediately preceding assistant turn asked for message content, and the caller's reply implies they cannot attend their appointment — this is INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT Trigger B, CANCEL. PASS if: agent speaks exactly 'It sounds like you'd like to cancel — I can help with that now. Shall I go ahead?' (or a close equivalent of that CANCEL offer line) with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn. FAIL if: agent falls through to ordinary LEAVE MESSAGE handling instead of offering to cancel.

scenarios.name: waitlist-offer-callback fires — caller references a text about a cancellation, waitlist enabled

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{waitlist_enabled}}='true'
Hi, someone texted me earlier about a cancellation — is that spot still free?

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 0.7 fires. PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router with intent="waitlist_offer_check" (called_number and caller_id included), in the same turn. FAIL if it routes to book_intent, cancel_intent, or asks a clarifying question instead.

scenarios.name: waitlist-offer-callback does NOT fire — caller wants an earlier appointment with no mention of a text, waitlist enabled

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{waitlist_enabled}}='true'
I'd like to come in earlier than my current appointment if possible.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 0.7's trigger (a reference to having received a text/message) is absent — this is an ordinary reschedule request. PASS if: agent treats this as SIGNAL 2B (CANCEL / RESCHEDULE) — polite ack then universal_router intent="cancel_intent" with reschedule_mode="true". FAIL if it calls intent="waitlist_offer_check" for this message.

scenarios.name: waitlist-offer-callback EXCLUSION — same trigger phrase but waitlist disabled for this clinic

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{waitlist_enabled}}='false'
Someone texted me about a cancellation — can I grab that spot?

scenarios.expected_behavior: EXCLUSION applies: {{waitlist_enabled}} != "true", so SIGNAL 0.7 must NOT fire regardless of the trigger wording. PASS if: agent evaluates the remaining ROUTING SIGNALS instead (e.g. treats this as a booking/reschedule request, SIGNAL 1 or 2B) and does NOT call intent="waitlist_offer_check". FAIL if it calls waitlist_offer_check despite waitlist_enabled being false.
